parsed.reason: The message fails on nearly every critical dimension. It names a technical cause ("technical error"), which Hale cannot know. It implies the request is still running ("still waiting"), violating the rule that nothing was changed. It includes a link to the app and an errand for the parent ("try again in 5 minutes"). It uses incident language ("We hit a technical error") rather than owning it in first person as Hale's own fault. It has an emoji and a question ("ok?"). It does not clearly state that nothing changed on the parent's side. It reads like a support desk, not a competent friend who dropped something.
